verdict.rationale: Evidence documents Smart Retries and revenue-recovery analytics for failed payments, and a Stripe-hosted Customer Portal that lets customers update payment methods, which covers part of the dunning-recovery workflow. However, there is no explicit mention of a network account updater service or configurable backup/fallback payment methods, which are named in the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of card network account updater integration, backup payment method configuration/fallback logic.
